newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT says licence delay may affect future business.
newsitem.headline: NTT says licence delay may affect future business.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) said on Wednesday that a delay in granting a U.S. licence for its international business may affect its international business plans in the future, although an immediate impact was unlikely.

Asked at a news conference what the effect of the delay would be on NTT's future international business, company president Junichiro Niyazu replied: "We are very concerned about a delay in one country."

He added that NTT would consider what measures to take in light of the delay with Japan's Posts and Telecommunications Ministry but said that he did not anticipate an immediate impact on NTT's international business plans.
The company president also said that NTT would need to take steps following a recent scandal at Nomura Securities Co Ltd involving suspected illegal transactions.
"We need to take some counter-measures, but at the moment we are waiting to see how things develop," he said when asked if the scandal would affect NTT's business ties with the brokerage.
